items.question: Which divine aspects receive obeisance as contraction-expansion of creation and cyclic leader of men?
premises: Obeisance is offered to contraction and expansion of creation.
Obeisance is offered to cyclic leader of men.
The salutation names two divine aspects.
items.inference: The verse salutes the deity as both cosmic process and cyclic human leader.
uncertainties: Exact deity identity is not specified by the tokens.
items.plain_english: Obeisance to the contraction and expansion of creation; obeisance to the cyclic leader of men.
